_comment: PLAN_088 rights lens data, verbatim (docs/plans/PLAN_088_evidence.json lenses['lens:rights'].data). Read-only research 2026-09-25 of the official terms pages (some via search excerpt where the fetch failed; see quote/caveats). SPEC_142 applies the cited tightenings in app/catalog/rights.py and keeps loosenings as proposals.
